faq.q: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a: Use the Book Now page to choose your treatment and time and confirm securely online, or call us on 07832839298.

faq.q: Do I pay when I book?
faq.a: Treatwell shows the payment options and any deposit or prepayment requirement that applies to the treatment you select. Review those details before confirming your booking.

faq.q: Do I need a consultation first?
faq.a: For laser and advanced skin treatments we recommend a consultation so the clinic owner can assess your skin and build a personalised plan. You can book a consultation the same way as any treatment.

Some treatments — such as laser, electrolysis and lash lifts — do require a patch test beforehand to make sure the treatment is suitable for you. If you're not sure whether your treatment needs one, please contact the studio and we'll let you know.

Please give us at least 24 hours' notice if you need to reschedule or cancel. Cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice, or no-shows, may be charged. Deposit terms are shown during booking — see our policies for details.

Adults aged 18 and over can book any of our treatments. Younger clients may be suitable for selected treatments too — suitability is always assessed individually with the practitioner at a consultation first. Anyone under 18 needs written consent from a parent or guardian, who must stay with them throughout the appointment.

Injectable and advanced regenerative treatments are for clients aged 18 and over only.
Call or text 07832839298, email info@lumidermaesthetics.co.uk, or message us on Instagram @lumi.derm.aesthetic.

bio.title: Clinically minded care, delivered calmly
paragraphs: Lumi Derm Aesthetics offers advanced skincare in a calm, professional setting. Treatments are planned carefully and delivered with technology and products chosen for safety, quality and results.
Every appointment begins with a real conversation. We take time to understand your skin, your concerns and your goals, then recommend what is likely to help and what is worth leaving alone.
The aim is to support healthier-looking skin, soften what bothers you and help you feel more comfortable in your own skin.
bio.role: Founder & Lead Practitioner, Lumi Derm Aesthetics

clinic.title: A quiet Docklands studio for skin, laser and body care
clinic.lead: Lumi Derm Aesthetics is a private treatment space in London Docklands. The approach is simple: understand the concern, explain the options clearly, and keep each appointment focused on the client.

cards.title: What the clinic offers
cards.copy: Facials, chemical peels, skin boosters, mesotherapy, PRP, laser hair removal, vascular laser treatments, electrolysis for hair and blemish removal, lymphatic drainage and Endospheres therapy.

cards.title: What matters
cards.copy: Appointments are one-to-one, treatment plans are tailored, and product choices are considered carefully.

concerns.title: The concerns we can help with
concerns.copy: Most clients come in with something specific they want to improve: hair growth, texture, dullness, redness, thinning hair, puffiness or skin that no longer feels like theirs. These are the concerns treated most often.

treatments.title: Advanced treatments, planned with restraint
treatments.copy: The clinic offers laser, regenerative, skin and body treatments, but the plan stays focused: what is useful, what is safe, and what makes sense for your skin.

benefits.title: We only recommend what is right for you

cta.title: Ready when you are
